en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Ja`far al-Himyari narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi’l Khattab narrated to us from al-Hasan b. Mahbub from Abi Ayyub from Muhammad b. Muslim from Abi Ja`far al-Baqir (as). He said: I heard him say:
How beautiful are good deeds after sins! How ugly are sins after good deeds!
